# Host scope. Faith-wide status is reserved for the Sanhedrin.
kehillah_reform_can_core_trigger = {
    knows_tenet = $TENET$
    OR = {
        NOT = { $TENET$ = tenet:tenet_kehillah_temple_service }
        kehillah_temple_service_available_trigger = yes
    }
    OR = {
        NOT = { $TENET$ = tenet:tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation }
        has_character_flag = kehillah_prophetic_calling
        has_character_flag = kehillah_prophetic_revival_recognized
        rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation }
    }
    rite ?= {
        has_at_least_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = permitted }
        NOT = { rite_has_tenet = $TENET$ }
        OR = {
            rite_can_choose_tenet = $TENET$
            any_rite_tenet = {
                save_temporary_scope_as = kehillah_reform_drop_candidate
                prev = { pam_rite_can_swap_exclusive_ascetic_tenet_trigger = { NEW = $TENET$ DROPPED = scope:kehillah_reform_drop_candidate } }
            }
        }
    }
}
kehillah_reform_can_permit_trigger = {
    kehillah_is_sanhedrin_head_trigger = yes
    knows_tenet = $TENET$
    rite ?= {
        NOT = { has_at_least_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = permitted } }
        NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = prohibited } }
    }
}
kehillah_reform_can_ban_trigger = {
    kehillah_is_sanhedrin_head_trigger = yes
    knows_tenet = $TENET$
    rite ?= { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = prohibited } } }
    faith = { NOT = { any_faith_rite = { rite_has_tenet = $TENET$ } } }
}
kehillah_reform_can_lift_trigger = {
    kehillah_is_sanhedrin_head_trigger = yes
    knows_tenet = $TENET$
    rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = prohibited } }
}
# Tenet scope, HOST parameter. Shared by enumeration and availability.
kehillah_reform_candidate_trigger = {
    save_temporary_scope_as = kehillah_reform_candidate
    $HOST$ = {
        OR = {
            kehillah_reform_can_core_trigger = { TENET = scope:kehillah_reform_candidate }
            kehillah_reform_can_permit_trigger = { TENET = scope:kehillah_reform_candidate }
            kehillah_reform_can_ban_trigger = { TENET = scope:kehillah_reform_candidate }
            kehillah_reform_can_lift_trigger = { TENET = scope:kehillah_reform_candidate }
        }
    }
}
kehillah_reform_any_motion_trigger = {
    exists = rite
    any_character_tenet = { knowledge_filter = known kehillah_reform_candidate_trigger = { HOST = prev } }
}
# Rite scope. Never remove a core unless the replacement pair remains legal.
kehillah_reform_pair_valid_trigger = {
    rite_has_tenet = $DROP$
    OR = {
        rite_can_choose_tenet = $NEW$
        pam_rite_can_swap_exclusive_ascetic_tenet_trigger = { NEW = $NEW$ DROPPED = $DROP$ }
    }
}
kehillah_reform_choice_valid_trigger = {
    exists = var:kehillah_reform_rite
    rite ?= var:kehillah_reform_rite
    var:kehillah_reform_topic ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = kehillah_reform_chosen_topic }
    var:kehillah_reform_replacement ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = kehillah_reform_chosen_drop }
    OR = {
        AND = {
            var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:core
            kehillah_reform_chosen_can_core_trigger = yes
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    exists = var:kehillah_reform_replacement
                    rite = { kehillah_reform_pair_valid_trigger = { NEW = scope:kehillah_reform_chosen_topic DROP = scope:kehillah_reform_chosen_drop } }
                }
                AND = {
                    NOT = { exists = var:kehillah_reform_replacement }
                    rite = { NOT = { pam_rite_is_at_core_tenet_cap_trigger = yes } rite_can_choose_tenet = prev.var:kehillah_reform_topic }
                }
            }
        }
        AND = { var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:permit kehillah_reform_chosen_can_permit_trigger = yes }
        AND = { var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban kehillah_reform_chosen_can_ban_trigger = yes }
        AND = { var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:lift kehillah_reform_chosen_can_lift_trigger = yes }
    }
}
kehillah_reform_delegate_favours_trigger = {
    involved_activity.var:kehillah_synod_takkanah ?= flag:tenet_reform
    exists = involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic
    OR = {
        AND = {
            NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban }
            OR = {
                has_personal_tenet = involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic
                rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = prev.involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic }
            }
        }
        AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous NOT = { has_personal_tenet = involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic } }
    }
}
kehillah_reform_delegate_opposes_trigger = {
    involved_activity.var:kehillah_synod_takkanah ?= flag:tenet_reform
    exists = involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic
    OR = {
        AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic }
        AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } has_trait = zealous NOT = { knows_tenet = involved_activity.var:kehillah_reform_topic } }
    }
}

kehillah_reform_chosen_can_permit_trigger = { exists = var:kehillah_reform_topic var:kehillah_reform_topic = { save_temporary_scope_as = kehillah_reform_chosen_topic } kehillah_reform_can_permit_trigger = { TENET = scope:kehillah_reform_chosen_topic } }

kehillah_reform_chosen_can_ban_trigger = { exists = var:kehillah_reform_topic var:kehillah_reform_topic = { save_temporary_scope_as = kehillah_reform_chosen_topic } kehillah_reform_can_ban_trigger = { TENET = scope:kehillah_reform_chosen_topic } }
